reason: We spend about 1,500 a year on frame protection and rely on the factory film, so 19 euro per m2 is a huge jump for something I have never seen on a Maltese site. I buy the cheapest option that is good enough, and a 150 m2 minimum plus 50% deposit does not suit us.
objection: I have never seen it used in Malta. Show me a local job. Who carries the risk if it damages the glass or will not peel off after months on site?
instead: Keep using the factory film on the profiles, with cheap tape and cardboard on glass where needed, and charge the main contractor for any cleaning or damage.
would_change_my_mind: A local reference job with a main contractor I know, a price near 5 to 6 euro per m2 all-in, and the main contractor agreeing to pay for it in the subcontract.
